method.touch_onset: first touch_time>0 frame i after a zero; t = (i + -1) * 0.01 s

envelope.time_reference: window centre, ms relative to touch onset

method.threshold: max(noise_db + X, -70 dBFS), X in {6, 12, 18}; primary X=12
method.decay: first frame after peak at peak_db - 10 dB, searched to +2000 ms
method.quiet_rule: skip if touch_time>0 in preceding 300 ms, or max touch_layer envelope dB in preceding 300 ms > -50.0 dBFS

onset_weight_kernel.pre_ms_note: midpoint of the 20-30 ms range; P5 of measured audio onset lags (+12 dB) is nan ms
onset_weight_kernel.peak_ms_note: median over sounds of per-sound median peak lag (nan ms), rounded to 10 ms
